preflight_before_mutation.public_truss_check: In a read-only transaction as the r6 registrar LOGIN principal, call public status_in_transaction and accepted_document_in_transaction for the exact document; require catalog revision 1, document revision 1 and SHA-256 equal the retained r6 acceptance receipt.
preflight_before_mutation.read_only_role_check: As direct local administrator, verify the exact 63-byte PostgreSQL-truncated reader role exists with LOGIN and no elevated attributes; verify module-reader/module-writer role names do not collide; verify consumer id has no registration and module-access state is absent or already exactly equal to the planned r6 grant.
preflight_before_mutation.read_only_role_check_sql: SELECT rolname,rolcanlogin,rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolinherit FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=ANY(%s); SELECT consumer_id,reader_oid,registration_id::text,checkpoint_bytes FROM truss.runtime_feed_consumer WHERE consumer_id=%s; SELECT document_id,module,reader_role,writer_role FROM truss.module_access WHERE document_id=%s AND module=%s;
preflight_before_mutation.stop_if: Any source identity/hash/revision mismatch, missing/unsafe reader login, pre-existing conflicting consumer, conflicting module access, role collision, or failure of public registrar/catalog read checks.

consumer.checkpoint: enroll full-source consumer at genesis before seed; capture returned checkpoint bytes and SHA-256
consumer.reader_role_membership: reader LOGIN inherits module-reader membership with SET FALSE
consumer.actual_role_existence: must prove exact role absent during read-only preflight before creation
consumer.module_access: Create the two distinct safe NOLOGIN roles; configure one Truss public ModuleAccessGrant for document ashlar-local-dev-typed-graph-r6-20261031, module m, with those roles; grant module-reader membership to the reader LOGIN and module-writer membership to the r6 registrar LOGIN using INHERIT TRUE, SET FALSE

seed.group: one atomic GroupSemanticInput applied through Truss public apply_in_transaction

feed_read.read_as: the same ordinary LOGIN reader role enrolled above, using its direct session identity and role=none
feed_read.expected_cursor_behavior: Genesis checkpoint is nextXid 0. The accepted catalog-registration request is an earlier retained writer transaction than the seed. With no ACK, one read can expose only the earliest transaction; the seed transaction cannot be reached without advancing the checkpoint, which remains out of scope until publication verification.
